diagnosis: The customer's export job (6 GB) has been running for seven hours, exceeding the six-hour stall threshold defined in kb-0005. Since the policy decision is escalate=False, the engineer should guide the customer to cancel and resubmit the job rather than filing an internal escalation.
reply: Thank you for contacting support regarding your export job EXP-40233. According to our guidelines, export jobs under 10 GB typically complete within an hour, and any job running for more than six hours is considered stalled. To resolve this, please cancel the current job and resubmit the export request.
